cg_window.rule: SM = (x_np - x_cg)/MAC_pect; print a ballast bay that can put the MEASURED CG anywhere in ballast_must_reach_m, so trim can follow the VLM NP without a reprint

hook.rule: rectangular cantilever stem, sigma = 6 F l / (b d^2) <= UTS/SF

material.test_conditions: 100 micrometre Alpha Grey V1 settings; 5 minute wash in at least 99% IPA; default post-cure. Studio Wash+Cure default is 5 minutes.

limits: no torsion of the fin about its span axis; the quarter-chord load is aft of the spar
no layer anisotropy, notch factor, cure variation, fatigue, impact or hand-handling loads
launch force profile, speed and alignment are unmeasured scenarios (SPEC-010 rule 4)
NP is a hand bracket, not a VLM or measurement; body lift beyond the Munk couple ignored
coupon properties are not fin-level verification (SPEC-010 analysis contract)

neutral_point_bracket.method: hand bracket: Helmbold + declared downwash + Munk couple; not VLM, not measured

cn_max.status: assumed flat-plate normal-force bound at large incidence during launch transients

effective_flange_over_t.status: declared shear-lag bound: membrane counted only within 20 t of the spar; the rest carries load but adds no stiffness

mass_kg.status: bracket: 8 g (light target) to 20 g (claude-05 plan upper estimate)

misalignment_deg.status: assumed: band line vs fin plane at launch, puts a_peak*sin() normal to fins

peak_over_mean_force.status: bracket of unknown force-time profiles; linear decay = ideal elastic band

strength_safety_factor.status: declared; covers notches, layer lines, thin-feature cure, handling

tip_deflection_over_span_cruise_max.status: declared shape-retention limit at 1 g trim load
